goal: Prevent external callers from arbitrarily mutating HTTP request state
Ensure request parsing transitions are handled safely within the request object itself
reviewability: Nothing is known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support with substantive review and testing across several contributors
Concept approval after exhaustively testing disconnect conditions against master (jeanpablojp)
Support for compiler-enforcing state transitions and returning the state enum (janb84)
Tested on Debian clang and approved after buffer cleanup was consolidated (winterrdog)
Approved after a fix for stalled requests when the send buffer is throttled (pinheadmz)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because this is an internal refactoring of HTTP request handling with no user-visible behavior change
Enforces internal invariants at compile time rather than by convention without performance impact
